author: KEXP
description: Power trio @LittleBarrieOfficial & Malcom Catto teeter between commotion and harmony with their genre-bending psych-funk sound. Live on KEXP from @transmusicalesOfficiel, we see their unique talents fuse together effortlessly through a performance of "My Now" and more.
title: Little Barrie & Malcolm Catto perform "My Now" & more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Little Barrie & Malcolm Catto performing live at ESMA in Rennes, France, during Trans Musicales 2025. Recorded December 3, 2025. 

Songs:
Electric War
‘Said Soul
Old Role
Rest In Blue
My Now

Barrie Cadogan - Vocals, Guitar
Lewis Wharton - Bass, Vocals
Malcolm Catto - Drums

Audio Engineer: Matt Ogaz
Audio Mix: Jon Roberts 
Audio Mastering: Julian Martlew

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Scott Holpainen & Luke Knecht
Editor: Jim Beckmann
